title: Distribute SSH Known Hosts / Authorized Keys Across Inventory
description: Scans each target host's SSH key into the controller's known_hosts (via ssh-keyscan), and/or pushes a public key into each target's authorized_keys -- for getting passwordless SSH working across a fleet using Ansible's own inventory instead of a hand-maintained hosts file. TARGET_HOSTS should be a plain inventory group name here, since the known_hosts play resolves it via groups[].

variables.name: TARGET_HOSTS
variables.prompt: Inventory group name to target (a plain group name, not a complex pattern)

variables.name: KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE
variables.prompt: known_hosts file to update on the controller

variables.name: SSH_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.prompt: SSH public key to install on each target host (leave empty to skip)

variables.name: SSH_USER
variables.prompt: Remote account to install the key for, on each target host

toggles.name: UPDATE_KNOWN_HOSTS
toggles.prompt: Scan and add each host's key to the controller's known_hosts
